an2.11:1.6: kāyaduccaritassa kho pāpako vipāko diṭṭh 'eva dhamme abhisamparāyañ ca: vacīduccaritassa . . . pe . . .: mano-duccaritassa pāpako vipāko diṭṭh 'eva dhamme abhisamparāyañ cā ti.
an2.11:1.7: So iti paṭisaṅkhāya kāyaduccaritaṃ pahāya kāyasucaritaṃ bhāveti: . . . pe . . . manoduccaritaṃ pahāya manosucaritaṃ bhāveti suddhaṃ attānaṃ pariharati.
an2.11:2.2: Tatra bhikkhave yam idaṃ bhāvanābalaṃ sekhānaṃ etaṃ balaṃ.
an2.11:2.3: Sekhaṃ hi so bhikkhave balaṃ āgamma rāgaṃ pajahati dosaṃ pajahati mohaṃ pajahati,
an2.11:2.4: rāgaṃ pahāya dosaṃ pahāya mohaṃ pahāya yaṃ akusalaṃ taṃ na karoti yaṃ pāpaṃ taṃ na sevati.
an2.11:2.6: Imāni kho bhikkhave dve balānī ti. 2. Dve 'māni
an2.12:2.2: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu satisaṃbojjhaṅgaṃ bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ virāganissitaṃ nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ.
an2.12:2.10: Imāni kho bhikkhave dve balāni. 3. Dve 'māni
an2.13:2.2: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu vivicc' eva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamajjhānaṃ upasampajja viharati:
an2.13:2.3: vitakka-vicārānaṃ vūpasamā ajjhattaṃ sampasādanaṃ cetaso ekodibhāvaṃ avitakkaṃ avicāraṃ samādhijaṃ pītisukhaṃ dutiyajjhānaṃ upasampajja viharati:
an2.13:2.4: pītiyā ca virāgā upekkhako ca viharati sato ca sampajāno sukhañ ca kāyena paṭisaṃvedeti yan taṃ ariyā ācikkhanti upekhako satimā sukha-vihārī ti tatiyajjhānaṃ upasampajja viharati:
an2.13:2.5: sukhassa ca pahānā dukkhassa ca pahānā pubb' eva somanassa-domanassānaṃ atthagamā adukkhamasukhaṃ upekhā-sati-pārisuddhiṃ catutthajjhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.

an2.14:1.4: Imā kho bhikkhave dve Tathāgatassa dhamma-desanā ti. 5.
an2.15:1.1: Yasmiṃ bhikkhave adhikaraṇe āpanno ca bhikkhu codako ca bhikkhu na sādhukaṃ attanā va attānaṃ paccavekkhanti tasm' etaṃ bhikkhave adhikaraṇe pāṭikaṅkhaṃ
an2.15:1.2: dīghattāya kharattāya vāḷattāya saṃvattissati bhikkhū ca na phāsuṃ viharissantī ti.
an2.15:1.3: Yasmiñ ca kho bhikkhave adhikaraṇe āpanno ca bhikkhu codako ca bhikkhu sādhukaṃ attanā va attānaṃ paccavekkhanti tasm' etaṃ bhikkhave adhikaraṇe pāṭikaṅkhaṃ
an2.15:1.4: na dīghattāya kharattāya vāḷattāya saṃvattissati bhikkhū ca phāsuṃ viharissantī ti.
an2.15:2.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave āpanno bhikkhu sādhukaṃ attanā va attānaṃ paccavekkhati?.
an2.15:2.2: Idha bhikkhave āpanno bhikkhu iti paṭisañcikkhati:
an2.15:2.3: Ahaṃ kho akusalaṃ āpanno kañcid eva desaṃ kāyena tam
an2.15:2.4: maṃ so bhikkhu addasa akusalaṃ āpajjamānaṃ kañcid eva desaṃ kāyena.
an2.15:2.5: No ce ahaṃ akusalaṃ āpajjeyyaṃ kañcid eva desaṃ kāyena na maṃ so bhikkhu passeyya akusalaṃ āpajjamānaṃ kañcid eva desaṃ kāyena.
an2.15:2.6: Yasmā ca kho ahaṃ akusalaṃ āpanno kañcid eva desaṃ kāyena tasmā maṃ so bhikkhu addasa akusalaṃ āpajjamānaṃ kañcid eva desaṃ kāyena.
an2.15:2.7: Disvā ca pana maṃ so bhikkhu akusalaṃ āpajjamānaṃ kañcid eva desaṃ kāyena anattamano ahosi:
an2.15:2.8: anattamano samāno anattamanavacanaṃ maṃ so bhikkhu avaca.
an2.15:2.9: Anattamanavacanāhan tena bhikkhunā vutto samāno anattamano ahosiṃ:
an2.15:2.11: iti mam eva tattha accayo accagamā suṅkadāyikaṃ va bhaṇḍasmin ti.
an2.15:2.12: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave āpanno bhikkhu sādhukaṃ attanā va attānaṃ paccavekkhati.
an2.15:3.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave codako bhikkhu sādhukaṃ attanā va attānaṃ paccavekkhati?
an2.15:3.2: Idha bhikkhave codako bhikkhu iti paṭisañcikkhati:
an2.15:3.3: Ayaṃ kho bhikkhu akusalaṃ āpanno kañcid eva desaṃ kāyena.
an2.15:3.4: Tāhaṃ imaṃ bhikkhuṃ addasaṃ akusalaṃ āpajjamānaṃ kañcid eva desaṃ kāyena.
an2.15:3.5: No ce ayaṃ bhikkhu akusalaṃ āpajjeyya kañcid eva desaṃ kāyena nāhaṃ imaṃ bhikkhuṃ passeyyaṃ akusalaṃ āpajjamānaṃ kañcid eva desaṃ kāyena.
an2.15:3.6: Yasmā ca kho ayaṃ bhikkhu akusalaṃ āpanno kañcid eva desaṃ kāyena tasmā ahaṃ imaṃ bhikkhuṃ addasaṃ akusalaṃ āpajjamānaṃ kañcid eva desaṃ kāyena.
an2.15:3.7: Disvā ca panāhaṃ imaṃ bhikkhuṃ akusalaṃ āpajjamānaṃ kañcid eva desaṃ kāyena anattamano ahosiṃ:
an2.15:3.8: anattamano samāno anattamanavacanāhaṃ imaṃ bhikkhum avacaṃ.
an2.15:3.9: Anattamanavacanāyaṃ bhikkhu mayā vutto samāno anattamano ahosi:
an2.15:3.11: iti mam eva tattha accayo accagamā suṅkadāyikam va bhaṇḍasmin ti.
an2.15:3.12: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave codako bhikkhu sādhukaṃ attanā va attānaṃ paccavekkhati.
an2.15:4.1: Yasmim bhikkhave adhikaraṇe āpanno ca bhikkhu codako ca bhikkhu na sādhukam attanā va attānaṃ paccavekkhanti tasm' etaṃ bhikkhave adhikaraṇe pāṭikaṅkhaṃ dīghattāya kharattāya vāḷattāya saṃvattissati bhikkhū ca na phāsuṃ viharissanti.
an2.15:4.2: Yasmiñ ca kho bhikkhave adhikaraṇe āpanno ca bhikkhu codako ca bhikkhu sādhukaṃ attanā va attānaṃ paccavekkhanti tasm' etaṃ bhikkhave adhikaraṇe pāṭikaṅkhaṃ na dīghattāya kharattāya vāḷattāya saṃvattissati bhikkhū ca phāsuṃ viharissantī ti. 6.
an2.16:1.1: Atha kho aññataro brāhmaṇo yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi
an2.16:1.2: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sāraṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so brāhmaṇo Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
an2.16:1.3: Ko nu kho bho Gotama hetu ko paccayo yena-m-idh' ekacce sattā kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ uppajjantī ti?
an2.16:1.4: Adhammacariyā visamacariyā hetu kho brāhmaṇa evam idh' ekacce sattā kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ uppajjantī ti.
an2.16:2.1: Ko pana bho Gotama hetu ko paccayo yena-m-idh' ekacce sattā kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ uppajjantī ti?
an2.16:2.2: Dhammacariyā samacariyā hetu kho brāhmaṇa evam idh' ekacce sattā kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ uppajjantī ti.
an2.16:3.1: Abhikkantaṃ bho Gotama abhikkantaṃ bho Gotama.
an2.16:3.2: Seyyathāpi bho Gotama nikkujjitaṃ vā ukkujjeyya paṭicchannaṃ vā vivareyya mūḷhassa vā maggaṃ ācikkheyya andhakāre vā telapajjotaṃ dhāreyya cakkhumanto rūpāni dakkhintī ti evam eva kho bhotā Gotamena anekapariyāyena dhammo pakāsito.
an2.16:3.3: Esāhaṃ Bhagavantaṃ Gotamaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmi dhammañ ca bhikkhusaṅghañ ca.
an2.16:3.4: Upāsakaṃ maṃ bhavaṃ Gotamo dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gatan ti. 7.

an2.18:1.1: Atha kho āyasmā Ānando yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi: ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho āyasmantaṃ Ānandaṃ Bhagavā etad avoca:

an2.18:1.3: Yam idaṃ bhante Bhagavatā ekaṃsena akaraṇīyaṃ akkhātaṃ kāyaduccaritaṃ vacīduccaritaṃ manoduccaritaṃ tasmiṃ akaraṇīye kayiramāne ko ādīnavo pāṭikaṅkho ti?.

an2.18:1.9: kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ uppajjati.
